title: ResearchRubrics: A Benchmark of Prompts and Rubrics For Evaluating Deep Research Agents
authors_zh: Manasi Sharma, Chen Bo Calvin Zhang, Chaithanya Bandi, Clinton J. Wang, Ankit Aich, Huy Nghiem, Tahseen Rabbani, Ye Htet, Brian Jang, Sumana Basu, Aishwarya Balwani, Denis Peskoff, Marcos Ayestaran, Sean M. Hendryx, Brad Kenstler, Bing Liu
paper_type_zh: 深度研究 Agent 的人类 rubric 评测基准
best_for_zh: 需要评估多文档研究、长报告 Judge 或证据支撑推理的研究者。
one_line: ResearchRubrics pairs realistic research prompts with human-written criteria for granular agent evaluation.
ResearchRubrics 用人类撰写并复核的细粒度准则，衡量深度研究 Agent 的事实依据、推理与表达。
why: It evaluates justification and synthesis rather than only short factual retrieval.
inclusion_reason: ResearchRubrics releases human-authored rubrics for evaluating open-ended deep-research agents.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Deep-research agents retrieve multiple sources and produce long reports with many valid formulations and dependence on changing web content. Citation counts, text similarity, or one holistic rating cannot identify whether facts, derivations, or implicit constraints are missing, and they make comparisons across agents and dates unstable.

ResearchRubrics creates a common evaluation surface from realistic prompts and expert criteria, decomposing reports into checkable grounding, reasoning, synthesis, citation, communication, and instruction-following requirements with human and model-judge protocols.

深度研究代理会检索多源材料并生成长报告，答案不存在唯一措辞，且依赖动态网页。引用数量、文本相似度或整体主观分无法指出报告究竟遗漏了事实、推导还是隐含约束，也难以在不同代理和不同日期之间稳定比较。

ResearchRubrics 以真实研究提示和专家细则建立统一评测面，将长报告拆成事实依据、推理、综合、引用、表达和指令遵循等可检查要求，并提供人类与模型 Judge 协议。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The final release contains 101 single-turn research prompts across ten domain categories and more than 2,500 weighted expert rubrics, usually 20–43 criteria per task. Tasks are labelled for conceptual breadth, logical nesting, and exploration. Built with over 2,800 hours of human labour, the release includes prompts, rubrics, complexity metadata, and evaluation code for deep-research scoring, judge calibration, and error localisation.
正式版包含 101 个跨十类领域的单轮研究提示和 2,500 余条专家加权 rubric，每题通常有 20–43 条准则，并标注概念广度、逻辑嵌套和探索性三类复杂度。项目投入 2,800 余小时人工工作，公开提示、rubric、复杂度元数据和评测代码，可用于深研报告评分、Judge 校准和错误定位。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select tasks: Experts design open research questions across business, technology, science, and social analysis, excluding single-lookup tasks.
  1. Decompose rubrics: Explicit requirements, implicit context, synthesis, citations, and communication are converted into 20–43 weighted criteria per prompt.
  1. Label complexity: Tasks are graded for conceptual breadth, logical nesting, and exploration to control structural difficulty.
  1. Evaluate reports: Humans or LLM judges assign criterion-level compliance; reproduction must fix retrieval cutoff, agent budget, judge, and web snapshot.

1. 选择任务： 专家设计跨商业、技术、科学和社会分析的开放研究问题，并排除单次检索即可回答的任务。
  1. 拆分准则： 对每个提示提取显式要求、隐含背景、跨文档综合、引用和表达标准，写成 20–43 条带权判据。
  1. 标注复杂度： 依据概念广度、逻辑嵌套深度和探索开放度为任务分级，控制任务结构。
  1. 评估报告： 人类或 LLM Judge 逐条判定并计算加权 compliance；复现需固定检索截止日、代理预算、Judge 和网页快照。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Leading systems such as Gemini Deep Research and OpenAI Deep Research remain below 68% average rubric compliance, mainly because of missed implicit context and weak reasoning over retrieved evidence. Binary model-judge agreement with humans reaches about 0.76 F1, showing scalability but imperfect reliability. The results support diagnostic rubrics while dynamic web content and retrieval budgets still affect comparability.
领先的 Gemini Deep Research 与 OpenAI Deep Research 在统一协议下平均 rubric 遵循率仍低于 68%，主要失败来自遗漏隐含上下文和未对检索证据进行充分推理。模型 Judge 与人类二元判定最高约 0.76 F1，说明自动评测可扩展但并非无误。结果支持细则的诊断价值，但动态网页和检索预算仍影响可比性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier deep-research benchmarks often rely on final answers, citation accuracy, or broad criteria generated on demand. ResearchRubrics fixes expert task-level criteria in advance and characterises tasks through three complexity axes, enabling reuse and concrete diagnosis across agents. It is not a new search agent but an auditable criterion-level representation of open-web research.
既有深研基准常依赖最终答案、引用正确率或由 LLM 临时生成的宽泛标准。ResearchRubrics 先由专家固定任务级细则，再用三轴复杂度刻画任务，使同一 rubric 可跨代理复用并诊断具体缺失。它不是新的搜索代理，而是把开放网页研究变成可审计的准则级对象。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Web facts change and fixed rubrics may become stale; retrieval dates and evidence snapshots should be saved.
  1. Limitation 2: Independent criterion scoring can underweight document-level coherence and contradictions.
  1. Limitation 3: An F1 around 0.76 still leaves boundary errors, requiring human sampling for high-stakes comparisons.

1. 局限1： 网页事实会变化，固定 rubric 可能过期，运行时应保存检索日期和证据快照。
  1. 局限2： 独立准则评分会弱化报告整体连贯性与内部矛盾检查。
  1. 局限3： 约 0.76 F1 仍意味着边界误判，高风险比较需人工抽查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: For agent comparison, fix the 101 tasks, retrieval budget, and time window and report dimension-level compliance.
  1. Use case 2: For judge development, measure criterion-level F1, false negatives, and weight sensitivity using expert labels.
  1. Use case 3: Real-time events or private databases require updated evidence and rubrics rather than static scores.

1. 使用场景1： 比较深研代理时，固定 101 个任务、检索预算和时间窗口，报告分维度 compliance。
  1. 使用场景2： 开发 Judge 时，用专家判据测准则级 F1、漏判率和权重敏感性。
  1. 使用场景3： 实时事件或私有数据库任务需要更新证据和 rubric，不能直接沿用静态分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Evaluate long reports with 101 realistic prompts and more than 2,500 expert criteria.
  2. Method: Task filtering, atomic criteria, three-axis complexity, and criterion compliance.
  3. Data: Prompts, 20–43 rubrics per task, complexity fields, and code are released.
  4. Evidence: Leading agents remain below 68%; judge–human F1 reaches about 0.76.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for deep-research agents; freeze web time, budget, and judge.

1. 一句话定位： 用 101 个真实研究提示和 2,500+ 专家准则评估长报告。
  2. 方法抓手： 任务筛选、细则原子化、三轴复杂度和逐条 compliance。
  3. 数据抓手： 公开提示、20–43 条/题 rubric、复杂度字段和代码。
  4. 证据锚点： 领先代理低于 68%，Judge 与人类最高约 0.76 F1。
  5. 复用决定： 适合深研 Agent；必须冻结网页时间、预算和 Judge。
